project.boundarySource: Curated Olney visitor boundary derived from ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024)
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-09: 23 of 115 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown. Bedfordshire and Northamptonshire standalone attraction audit added 2026-08-09. These are explicit Home-only regional destinations and do not alter the host town planner or tourist rating.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Olney qualifies as a local detour through Cowper and Newton Museum and Olney Market Place and historic townscape. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Amazing Grace, Georgian streets and a gentle riverside town
townGuide.intro: Olney’s strongest thread is literary: William Cowper and John Newton connect the museum, church and town to Amazing Grace, while the long Market Place and Ouse-side walks create an attractive setting.
